recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed unless Patient Care reopens the later removal decision or explicitly decides to add a status reason directly on the remaining CarePlan.activity backbone.
issue_request: FHIR-4037 was a Published Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, requesting a coded CarePlan.activity.statusReason for cancelled, not-done, or on-hold activities, using CodeableConcept and an example binding.
initial_application: No commit explicitly names FHIR-4037. Git history shows db4ace37c6615c9732f958d34d6286fe739fc657 added CarePlan.activity.detail.statusReason as 0..1 CodeableConcept with the CarePlanActivityStatusReason binding name during the March 2015 CarePlan revamp. Later same-family binding issues FHIR-6212 and FHIR-22729 filled in the example-binding/value-set trail and are already audited on the combined branch.
additional_context: FHIR-26064 later renamed activity.detail to plannedActivityDetail, and FHIR-39101 later removed CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail and all children from the active CarePlan model in favor of CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityReference. On the combined branch, CarePlan remains active but the old plannedActivityDetail/statusReason block is inside an XML comment, and XML parsing of the active StructureDefinition finds no active CarePlan statusReason paths.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing CarePlan.activity.statusReason or editing the commented historical plannedActivityDetail.statusReason block would conflict with the later FHIR-39101 model decision.

Removed CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail and all children from the active model, superseding the old inline statusReason element in the current build.
